import random

from txn_simulator import Workload
from workloads import WORKLOAD_1, WORKLOAD_2, WORKLOAD_3

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START

def get_best_schedule(workload, num_seqs):
    """
    GRASP-style hybrid: multi-restart randomized greedy construction
    followed by local search (adjacent-window swaps + single-transaction
    relocations) on each constructed schedule, all within a time budget.

    Greedy passes build candidate orderings by appending the sampled
    transaction that minimizes full-sequence cost. Local search then
    refines each candidate (and the best-so-far) with first-improvement
    swap/insert moves, which can fix isolated bad conflict orderings
    that greedy construction cannot reach.
    """
    import time

    n = workload.num_txns
    deadline = time.time() + 100

    def greedy_pass(num_samples):
        start_txn = random.randint(0, n - 1)
        txn_seq = [start_txn]
        remaining_txns = [x for x in range(n) if x != start_txn]
        while remaining_txns:
            k = min(num_samples, len(remaining_txns))
            candidates = random.sample(remaining_txns, k)
            min_cost = float("inf")
            min_txn = candidates[0]
            for t in candidates:
                cost = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(txn_seq + [t])
                if cost < min_cost:
                    min_cost = cost
                    min_txn = t
            txn_seq.append(min_txn)
            remaining_txns.remove(min_txn)
        return workload.get_opt_seq_cost(txn_seq), txn_seq

    def local_search(seq, cost, deadline):
        """First-improvement local search: swaps and relocations."""
        seq = list(seq)
        improved = True
        while improved and time.time() < deadline:
            improved = False
            # swap moves (limited window for speed)
            for i in range(n - 1):
                for j in range(i + 1, min(i + 6, n)):
                    if time.time() >= deadline:
                        return cost, seq
                    seq[i], seq[j] = seq[j], seq[i]
                    c = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(seq)
                    if c < cost:
                        cost = c
                        improved = True
                    else:
                        seq[i], seq[j] = seq[j], seq[i]
            # relocation moves: remove txn at i, insert at j
            for i in range(n):
                if time.time() >= deadline:
                    return cost, seq
                t = seq.pop(i)
                for j in range(n):
                    if time.time() >= deadline:
                        seq.insert(i, t)
                        return cost, seq
                    seq.insert(j, t)
                    c = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(seq)
                    if c < cost:
                        cost = c
                        improved = True
                        break
                    seq.pop(j)
                else:
                    seq.insert(i, t)
        return cost, seq

    # initial construction + refinement
    best_cost, best_seq = greedy_pass(12)
    best_cost, best_seq = local_search(best_seq, best_cost, deadline)
    while time.time() < deadline:
        cost, seq = greedy_pass(10)
        if cost < best_cost:
            cost, seq = local_search(seq, cost, deadline)
            if cost < best_cost:
                best_cost, best_seq = cost, seq
        # also periodically refine the incumbent with fresh random moves
        if random.random() < 0.5:
            cost, seq = local_search(best_seq, best_cost, deadline)
            if cost < best_cost:
                best_cost, best_seq = cost, seq
    return best_cost, best_seq

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

def get_random_costs():
    workload_size = 100
    workload = Workload(WORKLOAD_1)

    makespan1, schedule1 = get_best_schedule(workload, 10)
    cost1 = workload.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule1)

    workload2 = Workload(WORKLOAD_2)
    makespan2, schedule2 = get_best_schedule(workload2, 10)
    cost2 = workload2.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule2)

    workload3 = Workload(WORKLOAD_3)
    makespan3, schedule3 = get_best_schedule(workload3, 10)
    cost3 = workload3.get_opt_seq_cost(schedule3)
    print(cost1, cost2, cost3)
    return cost1 + cost2 + cost3, [schedule1, schedule2, schedule3]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    makespan, schedule = get_random_costs()
    print(f"Makespan: {makespan}")
